working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF, 0h/12h/24h) cluster typed by the authors as Mi4; cluster is composed primarily of developing Mi4 neurons (immature).
searches_performed: OLS4 REST search fbbt "immature" medulla/transmedullary/amacrine terms

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the medullary intrinsic neuron Mi4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Authors' typing taken at face value; stage 0-24h APF so the immature term immature medulla intrinsic neuron Mi4 is the matching developing form.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Medulla intrinsic narrow field neuron with both fine and bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M3 and M8, but with only fine arborizations in medulla layers M4 and M5, and only bleb-type arborizations in medulla layer M9 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It receives input from the lamina monopolar neuron L5 and photoreceptor R8 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is a GABAergic neuron (Takemura et al., 2017). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature (adult) form; cluster is 0-24h APF so the immature term is used.
